TASKADE AI BUILDER PROMPTS - SA STUDENT FOCUSED
MAIN PROMPT FOR TASKADE AI BUILDER:

"Build an AI-powered internship matching system for South African students that addresses the 46.1% youth unemployment crisis. The system should intelligently match students from all 11 official language backgrounds with relevant internship opportunities based on their skills, location (urban/township/rural), available transport, NSFAS status, and career goals. Include special consideration for students from disadvantaged backgrounds and those without prior work experience. Match confidence scores must explain WHY a match works, considering SA-specific factors like industry growth sectors, township accessibility, and company culture fit for diverse backgrounds. Make the interface mobile-first and data-light."
SUB-PROMPTS (Copy individually to Taskade AI Builder):

"Create a student profile system collecting: academic background, skills (technical + soft), home language, location/province, transport access (own car/taxi/bus), NSFAS recipient status, preferred industries, willingness to relocate, and career aspirations. Make forms mobile-optimized with progress saving for students with intermittent connectivity."

"Build an internship database capturing: company location, transport accessibility, stipend amount (or unpaid), language requirements, required experience level, industry sector, company size, diversity commitment, and growth opportunities. Tag opportunities as 'First-Time-Friendly' for students with no experience."

"Integrate AI matching algorithm using vector embeddings that weighs: skills match (40%), location/transport feasibility (25%), cultural fit (20%), financial viability (10%), growth potential (5%). Prioritize matches for students from disadvantaged backgrounds when companies indicate diversity goals."

"Create match explanation system in simple English explaining: 'Why this match?' with breakdown (Your business admin skills + Gauteng location + taxi route available = 85% match with ABC Corp Accounts Internship in Sandton). Include transport time estimates using Google Maps API for SA routes."

"Build feedback system tracking which matches lead to successful placements, improving algorithm for SA context. Track success rates by province, language group, and disadvantage factors to identify and fix bias."

"Design mobile-first results page with: large touch targets, minimal data usage, offline save functionality, share-via-WhatsApp button, and simple filtering (paid/unpaid, province, industry). Show stipend amounts prominently as this is critical for NSFAS students."
Province-based filtering (Gauteng, Western Cape, KZN, etc.)
Stipend vs unpaid clarity (critical for students without NSFAS)
Language preference matching (not all students fluent in English)
First-time intern badges (reduce intimidation for inexperienced students)
🤖 PRIORITY 2: AI CAREER GUIDANCE CHATBOT (SA Context)
MAIN PROMPT FOR TASKADE AI BUILDER:

"Create a FREE AI-powered career guidance chatbot for South African students facing the 46% unemployment crisis. The bot should provide personalized, empathetic career advice considering SA's economic reality: high unemployment, NSFAS funding issues, township/rural challenges, language diversity, and limited family career guidance. Chatbot must understand SA labor market data (growing sectors: tech, renewable energy, healthcare), local educational pathways (TVET colleges, universities, learnerships), and be sensitive to financial constraints. Responses should be encouraging, realistic about challenges, and action-focused. Must work on mobile with minimal data usage and include voice input for students uncomfortable typing in English."
SUB-PROMPTS (Copy individually to Taskade AI Builder):

"Build conversational AI interface with: simple language (avoid jargon), patient tone, cultural sensitivity for SA students, mobile-optimized chat bubbles, voice input option using Web Speech API, and auto-save conversation progress for intermittent connectivity. Start conversations with 'Sawubona' / 'Molo' / 'Dumela' (greetings in major SA languages) before switching to English."

"Integrate SA-specific career database including: high-growth sectors (tech, green energy, healthcare, agriculture tech), realistic salary expectations by province, educational requirements (matric, diploma, degree), TVET college options, learnership programs, skills development opportunities, and government initiatives like YES Program. Include township entrepreneurship opportunities and informal economy guidance."

"Create personalized recommendation engine that asks about: current situation (studying/graduated/NEET), subjects studied, skills (even informal ones), interests, location, financial situation (NSFAS/self-funded/working), family situation, and career dreams. Output: 3 realistic career paths with step-by-step actions, FREE resources, estimated timelines, and success stories of SA youth who followed similar paths."

"Build skills gap analysis tool: 'You have X, you need Y to reach your goal.' Recommend FREE learning resources: Google Digital Skills, Coursera financial aid, edX scholarships, local NGO training programs, YouTube channels, and SA government skills portals. Prioritize zero-cost options first."

"Add conversation memory tracking student progress over weeks/months. Send WhatsApp check-in messages: 'How's the Excel course going?' or 'Ready to apply for that internship we discussed?' Build trust and accountability for students without family career support."

"Design motivational response system that: acknowledges SA challenges ('I know finding work is tough right now'), celebrates small wins ('Completing that application is a big step!'), provides realistic hope ('Your situation is temporary, not permanent'), and offers actionable next steps ('Here's what you can do TODAY'). Include crisis support resources for students struggling mentally."
Realistic salary expectations by province and experience
MAIN PROMPT FOR TASKADE AI BUILDER:

"Build WhatsApp Business API integration for Intern Us that recognizes WhatsApp is THE primary communication tool for South African students (proven by university research). Enable students to: receive instant internship alerts, check application status, get deadline reminders, access quick career tips, and interact with AI chatbot - all via WhatsApp. System must work with low data, support basic feature phones (not just smartphones), and provide value even without visiting the website. Include multi-language support starting with English, isiZulu, and Afrikaans. Make it feel like chatting with a helpful friend, not a corporate bot."
SUB-PROMPTS (Copy individually to Taskade AI Builder):

"Set up WhatsApp Business API with Twilio/MessageBird for SA phone numbers. Create verification system using SA cell numbers (+27). Implement webhook receivers to handle incoming messages, media, and status updates. Ensure POPI Act compliance for data protection."

"Create message template library for key notifications: 'New internship in [Province] matching your profile!' / 'Application deadline tomorrow for [Company]!' / 'You matched 90% with [Opportunity] - apply now?' / 'Weekly career tip: ...' Keep messages under 160 characters when possible for basic phone compatibility."

"Build interactive menu system using WhatsApp buttons/lists: Main menu → [1] Find Internships [2] My Applications [3] Career Advice [4] Settings. For basic phones, accept number replies. Allow natural language: 'show me tech jobs in cape town' or 'where is my application?'"

"Integrate with student database to provide real-time updates: 'Your application status changed to INTERVIEW STAGE!' Include quick actions: 'Reply YES to schedule interview' or 'Reply HELP for interview tips.' Send reminders 24 hours before deadlines/interviews."

"Add user preference management: 'Reply DAILY/WEEKLY/URGENT for notification frequency' and 'Reply PROVINCES to select which areas interest you.' Respect data costs - don't spam. Include 'Reply STOP anytime to pause notifications.'"

"Create rich media support: Send CV templates as PDF, share opportunity details with images, send location maps for interview venues, share motivational videos (with data-saver warnings). Enable students to submit CVs directly via WhatsApp for quick applications."
